positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.locationName: College of Agriculture and Natural Sciences
positions.description:
My responsibilities included managing, reworking and creating websites under CNAS, which included websites like CAFÉ. Creating and managing these websites were done using HTML, CSS, Javascript, JQuery and PHP. Communicated with technical and non-techincal professionals to create recreate websites with modern designs and applications. Working alongside other interns to finish projects, such as a slideshow. These websites were hosted on web management systems such as Omniupdate.

Websites Managed: CNAS - cnas.ucr.edu | CAFÉ - cafe.ucr.edu

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description: I assisted graduate/undergraduate students and professors, with problems such as: wireless connection, installing software provided by the university such as Matlab and Solidworks, port forwarding, VPN, ssh tunnels and other computer problems that were brought to our attention. I was able to handling unexpected problems and tasks at hand, which required adapting to different situations. I also helped in maintaining and managing the help desk, software and laptop program websites which required HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Dining Staff
positions.description: I worked in a residential dining hall, serving students food. I had various responsibilities such as assisting head cooks and bakers, handling food and cleaning up dishes and the floors. I was required to have strong communication with customers and supervisors to provide the best dining experience for the students.
